solo.name: Solo
solo.tagline: You play one character. Three bots fill the rest.
solo.blurb: The raid game as it is normally played: you are responsible for one job and you have to trust — or work around — the three priority lists standing next to you.

commander.name: Commander
commander.tagline: You drive all four. Tactical pause.
commander.blurb: Nobody runs a priority list — every ability of every character is yours. F1–F4 or a click switches who you are commanding, and the fight pauses itself whenever something happens that you would want to react to. Real-time-with-pause, not a raid.

gambit.name: Gambit
gambit.tagline: You write the priority lists, then watch.
gambit.blurb: You do not play the fight at all — you program the four bots and press pull. The condition registry and every ability are yours to arrange, and you can run hundreds of headless pulls of a build before you watch a single one.
